cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The dishwasher's broken. Excellent: we'll serve the curry in rolls. No plates to wash.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are twelve guests and only six rolls.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Halve them. Open sandwiches: twice the servings, same bread.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hollow them out first. Edible bowls, and the crumbs thicken the curry. We've saved the flour too.

mechanism: A grades a pupil kitchen objections as design inputs for a smarter no-washing routine that it credits to its lessons.
confusable: Not merely happy about a broken machine: A invents a practical substitute and refines it using each inconvenience.
comparison: Exercise merged with transport versus servingware merged with food and thickener.
seedUse: Keep D44 curry/rolls/six-twelve/runoff/crumbs; S05 training in resourcefulness and checking explains A correction style.
